nodes.name: scenario-schema.md
nodes.summary: Strict JSON DSL schema for Virtuoso GUI Runner scenarios. Defines top-level fields (version=1.0, task_id, session_id, pid, display, cellview, steps), CellView/Step/Verifier/Rollback object shapes, and the full set of allowed operations (VCLI_LOAD, VCLI_CALL, WINDOW_*, DISMISS_DIALOG, CLOSE, KEY, TYPE, CLICK_REL, DRAG_REL, SCROLL, SCREENSHOT, VERIFY, RECOVER) plus executor semantics. Extra fields are rejected.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown reference doc with tables; describes JSON contract enforced by vgui_runner.

nodes.name: xdotool-cheatsheet.md
nodes.summary: Bilingual (Chinese-led) xdotool quick reference covering window search, geometry, activation, mouse/click/drag/scroll, typing, and key chord primitives. Documents the higher-level Python CLI wrapper at scripts/gui.py for env/state/find/shot/click/drag/scroll/type/key/wait/smoke subcommands.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown table-heavy reference; complements xdotool_cli.py.

nodes.name: add_fts.py
nodes.summary: Adds SQLite FTS5 full-text search virtual table on top of the fnd_functions row set so that the RSI query path can do BM25 semantic search.
nodes.languageNotes: Short procedural script (no functions defined); uses sqlite3 stdlib only.

nodes.name: generate_report.py
nodes.summary: Regenerates the tabbed RSI status HTML report from the SQLite knowledge base. Aggregates fnd_functions counts by version, manual vs verified, IC251 confidence buckets, synonym/param/error stats, top categories, verified function list, param examples by function, recent errors, and full RSI progress history.
nodes.languageNotes: Top-level script body (no functions); aggregates SQLite rows and writes report/rsi_report.html.

nodes.name: import_fnd.py
nodes.summary: Parses Virtuoso .fnd documentation files (IC231/IC618) using a multi-line regex and inserts them into the RSI SQLite knowledge base as fnd_functions rows with name, syntax, description, args count, category and version.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions: parse_fnd_file, import_version, main. Uses re, os, sqlite3, pathlib.

nodes.name: init_snippets.py
nodes.summary: Creates the snippets table (id, description, category, code, params, version, success_count, last_used) in skill_db.sqlite3 and seeds it with verified Virtuoso SKILL snippets (draw_rect, draw_polygon, draw_path, draw_line, save_cv, zoom_fit, etc.).
nodes.languageNotes: Procedural script; uses sqlite3 + json + datetime.

nodes.name: init_synonyms.py
nodes.summary: Initializes the synonyms table in the RSI database and seeds canonical→variant mappings (e.g., rect↔rectangle, instance↔inst, save↔write/store/commit, delete↔remove/rm/kill) used for query expansion.
nodes.languageNotes: Single main() entry point; uses sqlite3 + pathlib.

nodes.name: promote.py
nodes.summary: Promotes high-frequency snippet rows from the RSI knowledge base into a SKILL .il file (vcli_snippets.il) of named procedures (vcliDrawRect, vcliDrawPolygon, vcliDrawPath, vcliDrawLine, vcliSaveCv, vcliZoomFit, vcliSelectAll, vcliDeselectAll, vcliDeleteSelected, vcliListShapes) so they can be loaded into Virtuoso as vcli* commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions: name_to_proc, generate_il, main. Uses sqlite3, json, re, pathlib.

nodes.name: record_progress.py
nodes.summary: Creates the rsi_progress table and seeds a chronological list of milestone entries (date, phase, milestone, detail, functions_added, errors_recorded) used in the RSI HTML report.
nodes.languageNotes: Procedural; uses sqlite3 + datetime + pathlib.

nodes.name: rsi.py
nodes.summary: Main RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement) CLI for the Virtuoso SKILL knowledge base. Implements DB connection, synonym loading/query expansion, semantic search, exact function lookup with known params, function-call dispatch via vcli, auto-recording of results, knowledge-base status, and report regeneration. Command surface: 'rsi QUERY', 'rsi -f FUNC', 'rsi call FUNC ARGS', 'rsi record', 'rsi status', 'rsi report'.
nodes.languageNotes: Nine exported functions (conn, _load_synonyms, expand, search, lookup, record_failure, record_param, _handle_snippet, main); uses argparse, json, sqlite3, subprocess, datetime, pathlib. Largest file in batch.

nodes.name: rsi_export.py
nodes.summary: Exports and re-imports the RSI SQLite knowledge base as a single JSON file (synonyms, snippets, open errors, param examples, verified functions) for team sharing; imports validate and insert into the corresponding tables.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions: export, import_data. Uses sqlite3 + json + pathlib + datetime.

nodes.name: rsi_query.py
nodes.summary: RSI query CLI — semantic search, exact function lookup, prefix search, category listing, and error checking against the SQLite knowledge base. Implements an in-script synonym map for query expansion and runs against the fnd_functions_fts FTS5 virtual table.
nodes.languageNotes: Seven exported functions (get_conn, search, get_function, list_category, prefix_search, check_errors, main); uses argparse + sqlite3 + pathlib.

nodes.name: snippet_library.py
nodes.summary: Catalog of verified, parameterized, composable SKILL snippets for Virtuoso (draw_rect, draw_polygon, draw_path, draw_line, save_cv, zoom_fit, select_all, deselect_all, delete_selected, list_shapes, etc.). init() persists them into the snippets table so promote.py can later emit a .il file.
nodes.languageNotes: Single init() entry point; large module-level SNIPPETS tuple list with {{param}} placeholders.

nodes.name: test_rsi_e2e.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end test for the RSI workflow: query → vcli call → record. Drives remote Virtuoso over SSH (user1@192.168.1.111) using the dean-user1-37749 vcli session, exercises rsi_query.get_conn + get_function, and validates the 'draw a path' scenario.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions: vcli, main. Imports get_conn, get_function from local rsi_query.

nodes.name: test_stability.py
nodes.summary: Stability regression test that runs core RSI operations (status, search, exact lookup, snippet list, lookup of a known function, snippet invocation) three times in a row and asserts consistent output + exit codes.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions: run, check, test_round. Uses subprocess + sqlite3 + pathlib.

nodes.name: validate_ic251.py
nodes.summary: Live validation of fnd_functions against IC251 Virtuoso over SSH. For each candidate function calls `func(nil)` via vcli and interprets 'undefined function' vs argument errors to mark existence. Updates confidence column in the SQLite DB.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions: vcli_exec, function_exists, main. Uses sqlite3 + subprocess + json.

nodes.name: verify_db.py
nodes.summary: Integrity checks for the RSI SQLite DB: SQLite-vs-JSON backup consistency, presence of confidence on every record, signatures on verified functions, no orphan error_history rows, and per-version coverage stats.
nodes.languageNotes: Single verify() entry point; uses sqlite3 + json + pathlib.

nodes.name: verify_ic251.py
nodes.summary: Batch-verifies IC251 fnd_functions against a live Virtuoso via SSH+vcli. For up to 200 'ported' functions, calls funcName() and classifies result as 'verified', 'exists', 'not_exist', or 'timeout'.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions: check_func, main. Uses sqlite3 + subprocess + json.

nodes.name: xdotool_cli.py
nodes.summary: Full-featured xdotool-backed GUI debugger CLI. Implements subcommands env/state/find/shot/click/drag/scroll/type/key/wait/smoke around X11 primitives, with a session-state file at /tmp/gui_session.env and an action log at /tmp/gui_actions.log. Enforces a hard DISPLAY/xdotool environment gate.
nodes.languageNotes: 23 exported functions including build_parser and per-cmd cmd_* functions; uses argparse, subprocess, time, datetime, shutil, os, sys, SimpleNamespace.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Test package init for virtuoso-gui-debug. Injects the skill root (parent of tests/) into sys.path so 'from vgui_runner.model import …' resolves during unittest discovery (which only adds scripts/ and tests/).
nodes.languageNotes: Two-line import + sys.path tweak; documents the 2-level Skill packaging constraint.

nodes.name: fail.json
nodes.summary: Negative-path scenario fixture used by the gui_runner test suite: a scenario with a nonexistent VCLI_LOAD command and an inverted verifier expectation (expected:false on window_exists). Drives TestCliRunFake failure path.
nodes.languageNotes: Strict JSON matching scenario-schema.md v1.0; 7 top-level keys.

nodes.name: pass.json
nodes.summary: Positive-path scenario fixture used by the gui_runner test suite: a two-step scenario (loadDesign + WINDOW_WAIT for the 'Virtuoso' window). Drives TestCliRunFake happy path.
nodes.languageNotes: Strict JSON matching scenario-schema.md v1.0; 7 top-level keys.

nodes.name: test_cli.py
nodes.summary: unittest suite for the gui_runner.py CLI (not in this batch — invoked by SCRIPT_PATH). Five TestCase classes cover validate (valid/invalid/version), run with --executor=fake (pass/fail/refusal/invalid), run-live (skip-aware), machine-readable JSON-on-stdout contract, and a guard that the CLI never writes outside the explicit --output directory.
nodes.languageNotes: 5 classes (TestCliValidate, TestCliRunFake, TestCliRunLive, TestCliMachineReadableOutput, TestNoOutputOutsideDir) plus helpers (write_scenario, write_outcomes, clean_env, run_cli). Uses tempfile + subprocess heavily.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Marker package init for vgui_runner — the offline Virtuoso GUI runner foundation. Single-line docstring; no runtime code.
nodes.languageNotes: One-line module docstring.

nodes.name: rsi_report.html
nodes.summary: Tabbed HTML dashboard for the RSI knowledge base. Skipped by the extractor (rendered binary markup).
nodes.languageNotes: HTML, generated by scripts/generate_report.py — file skipped during structure analysis.
